value: Danish Energy Agency (Energistyrelsen) public report; no licence statement printed

Energistyrelsen (Danish Energy Agency) (2015). Kortlaegning af energiforbrug i virksomheder (Mapping of energy consumption in companies), January 2015, version 4 (19 January 2015). Prepared by Viegand Maagoe with Teknologisk Institut, EnviScan, Energi Midt and Agrotech; project no. 988. Companion to ens_2015_001 (savings potentials).

Danish report read in the original. Printed page numbers used (PDF page minus 2). Statistical survey: 57 branch notes, each with an energy matrix of 24 end uses x 20 carriers in GJ (2012, a few branches 2011). Only one technology-level number exists: the ~50% thermal efficiency of the stone-wool cupola furnace (p.205), loaded to the main file. Two other statements are not loaded: heat pump end use assumed 100% space heating with COP 3.0 (p.89, a modelling assumption) and wood-pellet boilers 'with 50% efficiency' (p.262, an odd remark on branch growth). Other-values holds, for every branch, the process-heat end uses (heating/cooking, drying, evaporation, distillation, firing/sintering, melting, other process heat up to and above 150 C) and the branch total, parsed with a script; row sums of all 24 end uses were checked against the branch total for all 57 branches. Not loaded: electricity end uses (lighting, motors, ventilation), transport and per-carrier splits, heat export, text on technology development. No cost data. Matrix 'Konverterings- og nettab' is included only in the branch total.
